tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Returns Luxor's 30mil plastic business card materials (clear, frosted, solid white), specs, every quantity tier with current prices (shipping included), turnaround times and optional fees. Call this first when a user asks about plastic business cards, prices or options.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Calculates the exact total in USD for an order: material, cards per set, number of sets (different names/designs), Priority Rush, Next Day Air, blind drop-shipping and an optional promo code. Applies the current sale and promo rules (they do not stack; the larger discount wins).

tools.name: search_designs
tools.description: Finds Luxor design template pages for a profession or industry (e.g. 'real estate agent', 'roofing', 'med spa', 'financial advisor'). Returns names, page URLs and preview images the user can open to pick a style.

tools.name: request_sample_kit
tools.description: Mails a free Luxor sample kit (clear, frosted and solid white 30mil cards) to a US address. Only call this when the user has asked for samples and provided their details.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Creates a real Luxor plastic business card order for the user and returns an order reference, the exact quote and (when online payment is enabled) a Stripe checkout_url for the user to pay. tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Looks up an existing order by its reference (e.g. C-AB-12345) and the customer's email.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Creates a real Luxor plastic business card order for the user and returns an order reference, the exact quote and (when online payment is enabled) a Stripe chec…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_designs · Public sink: create_order, order_status · Destructive: get_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_designs · Public sink: create_order, order_status · Destructive: get_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
